Name: Jonbow's Insects
Author: J0NB0W
Description:
KBKuriations gave me permission to adapt their Custom Critters butterflies [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27767](CC) British Butterflies[/url], Which I highly recommend, into farm animals too so those are also an option! Huge shout out to them they are lovely designs! The main butterfly is made by me along with all the other insects other than the scorpion which is base game.  KBKuriations' butterflies are available at Marnie's under the 2nd butterfly.

Adds:
9 Insects that produce bug meat along with a deluxe produce listed below they produce every 3 days!

﻿-Butterflies: Butterflies will bring you pollen which you can turn into Nectar using an Oil Maker to be sold.

﻿-Beetle: Will bring you jade.

﻿-Ladybug: Will bring you aphid which can be sold.

﻿-Spider/Scorpion: Will produce Venom which can be made into Oil of Garlic at an Oil Maker.

﻿-Roly-Poly: Will bring you Purple Mushrooms.

-Praying Mantis: Will bring you Hardwood.

﻿-Caterpillar: Will leave cocoons which can be turned into cloth.

﻿-Dragonfly: Will produce eggs which can be aged in a preserves jar and sold.


Likely more to come if there is interest if you have suggestions let me know! Please report any bugs you find in the posts tab!

You can find my animals here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28303]Jonbow's Animals[/url]
